name: Aparthotel Sonnleitn
beschreibung: The Aparthotel Sonnleitn is nestled in Kirchberg in Tirol, right next to the famed Kitzbühel mountain cable cars. The property provides modern apartments with kitchenettes alongside comfortable hotel rooms. An inviting breakfast room and a rejuvenating sauna area are available for guests to relax. Skiers will appreciate the ski boot room fitted with modern drying facilities. During the summer, it serves as a wonderful springboard for scenic hikes and cycling adventures. Its peaceful yet central location is a hallmark feature. The apartments are primed for self-catering, and the house is warmly and attentively run by the owners.
